transcript.content: Hello, I'm glad you could make it in today. What brings you in to see me?
I’ve kind of lost interest in the things I used to enjoy. Dance class, hiking, trying new recipes, game nights—they all feel like chores now, and I keep putting them off.
How long have you been feeling this loss of interest in things?
Since the robbery at my festival job—about two years and three months ago.
Do unwanted memories or images of the robbery pop into your mind even when you don't want them to?

Sometimes. If a cash box snaps shut, or someone comes up behind me when I’m in the kitchen, it just brings it all back really fast. I can hear the voices again, and my stomach drops like it’s happening right then.
Do you find yourself actively avoiding places, people, or situations that remind you of the robbery?
Yes. I turn down festival jobs, evening delivery work, and some shared kitchens because I don’t want to be reminded of that night or have that panic start again.
Do you find yourself constantly on guard, on edge, or easily startled since the robbery?

Yeah. In parking lots or when I’m picking something up, I’m always checking who’s around me, where my car is, and how quickly I could get out. Even when everyone else seems totally relaxed, I can’t really stop doing that.
